instruction: Read-only exploration or lookup: find files, grep, list usages, summarise code, or answer where or what something is. No edits are requested.
A fully specified mechanical change: rename, apply a given diff, bump a version, fix a typo or an import. Both the target and the change are explicit, so no diagnosis or design is needed.
Implement or fix a bounded feature or bug in known code with clear acceptance, typical pull-request-sized work. Includes fixing a failing test or bug whose cause is not yet known but is likely local.
An unclear root cause across modules; concurrency, security or performance analysis; architecture or design trade-offs; a large refactor; or work that has already failed twice.
